channel.title: ZDI: Published Advisories
channel.description: The following is a list of publicly disclosed vulnerabilities discovered by Zero Day Initiative researchers. While the affected vendor is working on a patch for these vulnerabilities, TrendAI customers are protected from exploitation by security filters delivered ahead of public disclosure. All security vulnerabilities that are acquired by the Zero Day Initiative are handled according to the ZDI Disclosure Policy.

item.title: ZDI-26-1009: (Pwn2Own) Synology DiskStation DS925+ C2 Identity Plugin Exposed Dangerous Method Information Disclosure Vulnerability

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 6.5. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2025-14713.
